programme: B.Tech Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
preamble: This course provides learners with in-depth knowledge of python programming. Learners get hands-on experience using various programming constructs (for, while, if) to solve engineering problems. The introduction of packages like NumPy and pandas provides learners with confidence to handle large complex data problems.
